notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Risk Register v1 workbook. seed: {"name":"Risk Register","version":"v1","kind":"RISK_REGISTER"}. Cover-sheet cells carrying the literal «bind» token and the yellow fill are filled by the engine; everything else is left blank for human authorship. Per-row Risk fields on the 'Risks' sheet (Title, Category, Severity, Likelihood, Description, Mitigation, Owner, Status) are intentionally NOT bound — the engine has no per-risk structured fields. The Cover 'risk overview' cell is filled with AI-written prose via `section.risk_overview` (declared in `deliverable-templates/risk-register.json`); previous binding dumped the raw `risks.bulletList` engine output which produced unreadable `[severity/category]`-prefixed lines.

entries.note: Cover > Risk overview — AI-written narrative summary + cross-cutting themes. Replaces the previous risks.bulletList raw dump. Per-row Risk fields on the Risks sheet are deliberately unbound (see top-level notes).
